ud6.10:6.1: Reading titthiyānaṁ with the Thai edition. The Sri Lankan and Burmese editions read, takkikānaṁ, “logicians.” The parallel passage in the Udānavarga (29.2) agrees with this latter version.
ud6.10:6.3: In DN 1, the Buddha criticizes the philosophies of many of his contemporaries for having been “hammered out by logic.”
